title: Polished Build Billable Package wizard
description:
The Build Billable Package flow is cleaned up for production: clearer step progress, simpler folder choices (customer folders as chips instead of a cluttered dropdown), and short plain-English tips instead of developer-style notes.

Who is affected: PipeShare users building customer packages on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Billable package wizard has a clean step progress header.
Customer save location uses folder chips plus an optional new-folder field.
Source folder lists are shortened; advanced folder picks are tucked under Looking in the wrong folder?
Wizard and toast copy rewritten for clear product language.
